senses.gloss: N. of a Ṛṣi (son of Bhṛgu, author of [[Rv. 10. 19.]]).

__1 Moving, motion. 
__2 Being deprived of, loss; deprivation. 
__3 Dying, perishing. 
__4 Sinking, falling. 
__5 Departure, deviation. 
__6 Flowing, trickling.
a. Moving, active; च्यवाना सुमतिं भुरण्यू [[Rv. 6. 62. 7.]] -m. N. of a Ṛṣi restored to youth by the Aśvins; युवं च्यवानमश्विना जरन्तं पुनर्युवानं चक्रथुः शचीभिः [[Rv. 1. 117. 13.]]

a. Causing to fall; अच्युतच्यावनोऽरीणां संस्कृतो विकृतिर्वृषः [[Mb. 12. 43. 9.]] 
-नम् Expulsion, driving away.
